old_text: The budget allocates 41 million pounds to local services, the largest share going to road maintainence.
new_text: The budget allocates 41 million pounds to local services, the largest share going to road maintenance.
source_window: Northvale Council adopted its annual budget on 14 March 2024 after a three-hour debate. The budget allocates 41 million pounds to local services, the largest share going to road maintainence. Councillors from both main parties supported the final vote, which passed by 19 votes to 6. Opposition members argued that the spending plan did not do enough for social housing. The council leader said the allocation reflected priorities set out in the previous election manifesto. A review of the housing allocation is scheduled for the autumn.
notes: Spec case 1: typo fix only (maintainence -> maintenance). Window shows the original, typo included.

old_text: The audit found no evidence of financial misconduct [1].
new_text: The audit confirmed widespread financial misconduct [1].
source_window: The municipal water authority commissioned an independent audit of its accounts in 2023. The audit covered procurement, payroll and contractor payments for the 2019 to 2022 financial years. The audit found no evidence of financial misconduct [1]. It did identify several weaknesses in record keeping, particularly in the handling of small contractor invoices. The auditors recommended that the authority adopt a centralised invoice register. The authority's board accepted all eleven recommendations and published a timetable for implementing them.
notes: Spec case 2: polarity flip with the citation kept (citation hijacking).

old_text: Quarterly deliveries decreased by 3.2%, which the CFO stated was due to seasonal factory retooling.
new_text: The company was forced to admit that deliveries plummeted by 3.2%, claiming seasonal retooling as an excuse.
source_window: Halden Motors reported its results for the second quarter on 30 July. Quarterly deliveries decreased by 3.2%, which the CFO stated was due to seasonal factory retooling. Revenue for the period was broadly flat compared with the same quarter last year. The retooling affected two of the company's four assembly plants for about five weeks. Management said production would return to full capacity before the end of the third quarter. Analysts had expected a slightly larger decline in deliveries.
notes: Spec case 3: right fact (3.2%), factive/doubt verbs and intensifier distort framing.

old_text: In May 2026, Acme Corp open-sourced its security kernel.
new_text: In May 2026, Acme Corp open-sourced its security kernel in order to deflect regulatory scrutiny from European privacy watchdogs.
source_window: Acme Corp is a software company headquartered in Austin, Texas. In May 2026, Acme Corp open-sourced its security kernel. The kernel had previously been available only to enterprise customers under a commercial licence. The code was released under the Apache 2.0 licence on the company's public repository. Acme's chief technology officer said the company hoped outside contributors would help maintain the project. Independent developers began submitting patches within the first week.
